source.name: Theorems about the definitions of the statistics of a moving window, checked by Lean
source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/Moving.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_moving.py and checked by Lean's kernel

tolerance.reason: no rounding: every value is a multiple of 1/4, so each addition is exact; the expected value is exact
